item.title: U.S. and Iran exchange taunts as attacks imperil fragile ceasefire
item.summary: Iran’s foreign minister warned the U.S. should be wary of being dragged into a “quagmire” after tensions flared in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Trump keeps changing his timeline for ending the Iran war
item.summary: The president has repeatedly suggested that the conflict was nearing a conclusion while simultaneously escalating threats against Tehran.

item.title: Trump orders military to pause Strait of Hormuz mission to allow time for peace talks
item.summary: Global stocks jumped and oil prices fell in reaction to Trump’s statement, which hailed “Great Progress” toward a peace deal. The mission, dubbed “Project Freedom,” had just begun.

item.title: Trump lashes out at Pope Leo again ahead of Rubio trip to Rome
item.summary: The criticism of the pontiff’s stance on Iran highlighted what Vatican officials have described as an unprecedented low in relations with the United States.

item.title: Some Democrats press Trump to break silence on Israel’s nuclear arsenal
item.summary: A letter from 30 lawmakers calls on the U.S. to expose Israel’s weapons program, which it doesn’t acknowledge and was built in secret beginning in the late 1950s.

item.title: Pro-Kremlin lawyer’s turn against Putin reveals rift in Russian power circles
item.summary: Ilya Remeslo was put in a psychiatric hospital after criticizing Vladimir Putin. Now free, he said that he will not stop his crusade against the Russian president.

item.title: Cuba’s mom influencers share rare view of struggles under U.S. fuel embargo
item.summary: A growing cohort are using Instagram and TikTok to share unmoderated coverage of the beleaguered island.

item.title: Hantavirus-hit cruise ship to head to Canary Islands as Swiss confirm new case
item.summary: More than 140 people remain on the Hondius, which will take about three days to reach the Spanish archipelago for screening. A local official has criticized the plan.
